key: Trainer, you know of the move Ally Switch, don't you?
en: Trainer, you know of the move Ally Switch, don't you?
ja: トレーナーさん、「サイドチェンジ」というわざをご存知ですか?

key: Reborn has a special technique for this move!
en: Reborn has a special technique for this move!
ja: リボーンには、この技専用の特殊な運用法があるんです!

key: Unlike in other regions, Ally Switch is used with negative priority as a pivot to switch out at the end of a turn rather than the beginning!
en: Unlike in other regions, Ally Switch is used with negative priority as a pivot to switch out at the end of a turn rather than the beginning!
ja: 他の地方とは違って、「サイドチェンジ」は優先度がマイナスで運用され、ターンの最初ではなく最後に入れ替わる「ピボット」として使われるんです!

key: Do consider what kind of tactical application this may have.
en: Do consider what kind of tactical application this may have.
ja: どんな戦術的な使い道があるか、考えてみてください。
